panels.title: Bundle tracker
panels.description: Time since the last bundle events per OPA server and bundle. Requests are polled regularly, so 'since last successful request' should stay low; red means the server stopped getting bundles. An activation only happens when the bundle changed, so it may legitimately be old.

panels.title: Plugin Status
panels.description: Current status of every OPA plugin, per server. Anything but OK is highlighted.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (clamp_max(ceil(increase(bundle_failed_load_counter{namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1)) or max by (pod) (0 * last_bundle_request{namespace=~"$namespace", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Bundle Load Health (failed loads in the last 5m)
panels.description: One tile per OPA server. FAILING if at least one bundle load failed within the last 5 minutes, otherwise OK. Short failures right after a pod start (the bundle-builder sidecar is not ready yet) clear after 5 minutes.
